panels.title: FARM vs SMART: true drive age
panels.description: Seagate's FARM log keeps lifetime counters that are not cleared when SMART is reset. Hours before SMART = FARM power-on hours minus SMART power-on hours: how long the drive ran before its SMART history was wiped (resold or recertified used drives). Source: farm-metrics.sh textfile collector, refreshed every 15 minutes. Drives without a FARM log are not listed.

targets.expr: max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_power_on_seconds{instance=~"$instance"}) / 3600 and on (instance, device) max by (instance, device) (smart_farm_power_on_seconds{instance=~"$instance"}) / 3600

max by (instance, device) (smart_farm_power_on_seconds{instance=~"$instance"}) / 3600 - on (instance, device) (max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_power_on_seconds{instance=~"$instance"}) / 3600)
max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_power_cycle_count{instance=~"$instance"}) and on (instance, device) max by (instance, device) (smart_farm_power_on_seconds{instance=~"$instance"}) / 3600

panels.title: Power-on hours: FARM vs SMART
panels.description: Gap between the two bars is time the drive ran before its SMART counters were reset.
